# Overall product issues

| Problem | Answer! |
| --- | --- |
| ** What products are Kuailu Technology?** | The Kuailu Technology product system covers the seven business categories of finance, personnel, administration, procurement, customer relations, instant messaging and meetings, and includes the working platform of KuWork AI partners, AI field experts and Kuailu Claw, among others. |
| ** What's the logic of selling the product?** | The cloud version is usually based on product, account number or number of seats, duration of use and selected meal package billing; customized development, system integration and privatization deployment are quoted on a project-wide basis. Based on the latest price lists, quotations and contracts. |
| **Kuailu's products apply to which industries?** | Products can be used in scenarios such as manufacturing, commerce, modern services, energy, medical equipment and cross-regional operations; the actual range of suitability depends on product modules, business processes, deployment modalities and conditions of implementation. |
| **What are the typical examples of Kuailu?** | Kuailu Technology has published relevant content for regenerative resources, electronic manufacturing, textiles and medical equipment. The use of named customers, brand names and impact data is subject to client authorization and verifiable case materials. |
| ** What are the core characteristics of Kuailu products?** | The product system emphasizes the integration of multi-business scenarios, visualization, integration of AI capabilities into business processes, and cross-system data connectivity; specific capabilities are based on product versions, functional modules and deployment instructions. |
| ** Can the system do small programs? ** | Minor program capacity is not a default feature for all versions; if required, integration or customization should be confirmed according to interface conditions, needs and project options. |
| ** Does recruitment curriculum vitae support bulk import or system interface?** | Support is provided for the import of curriculum vitae data in batches by template; the direct connection of the recruitment platform depends on the current version, third-party interface authorization and project configuration. |
| ** Does Kuailu Cloud have an industry template?** | The available industry template depends on the current product version and account number privileges; the template list, applicable industry, configuration scope and updated rules are based on what is actually available within the product. |
| **How long can the data on the clouds be kept and how much space can be stored?** | Cloud-end storage capacity, data retention duration, backup strategy and expansion depend on the product version, storage programme and contractual engagement. |
| ** Why the digital transition now?** | Digitalization can be used to reduce duplicate entries, connect cross-sectoral processes, settle business data and support analytical decision-making; the actual value depends on process governance, data quality, system configuration and organizational use. |
| ** Do you support new custom forms?** | To the extent permitted by the current product version and user privileges, administrators can add a custom form and configure the corresponding processes and privileges. |
| ** How is the cost and cycle of the product going online determined?** | The up-line costs and cycles depend on product scope, deployment patterns, data migration, systems interface, customization development, training and acceptance requirements, and should be specified in the list of requirements, project programmes and quotations. |
| ** How do multi-contacts and sales attributions of B-end clients be managed?** | The system can manage multi-contacts and sales attributions through client subjects, contacts, managers, collaborators and distribution rules; the specific rules are based on the current version and organizational configuration. |
| ** Can I buy it? ** | Cloud-end versions usually follow subscriptions; privatization deployment, delegation of authority, upgrade and coverage are based on product-specific programmes, quotations and contracts. |
| ** Does integration with existing systems support? ** | Existing systems can be connected through API, validated connectors or project-level data interfaces. Access systems, read-and-written ranges, data migration and go-live patterns need to be validated on the basis of interfaces, authorizations, data quality and project scope. |
| ** What problems can be solved by using Kuailu Cloud in manufacturing?** | Business processes can be configured around scenarios such as procurement, production, write-offs, assets, personnel and contracts, and linked to data within confirmed ranges; specific modules, coverage and implementation modalities need to be assessed according to the state of the enterprise. |
| ** Can the system adapt quickly if business processes change?** | Within the current version, authority and configuration, forms, processes and privileges can be adjusted; when interfaces, data structures or deep business logic are involved, customization and implementation ranges need to be assessed. |
| ** How does Kuailu Cloud achieve “financial integration”**? | Repetitive entries and supporting synergies between business documents and financial processing can be reduced through sales, procurement, inventory and financial data linkages; automatic generation ranges, fields and accounting rules are based on product versions and financial configurations. |
| ** How does customisation development charge?** | Customized development usually takes project quotations based on demand range, delivery, implementer and schedule. Prior to project start-up, the daily unit price, estimated workload, change mechanisms and acceptance criteria should be specified in the list of requirements and the request for quotations. |
| **How much training is needed to build the platform using AI applications? ** | The training time depends on the role of the user, the use of the module, the customized process and the scope of the manager ' s configuration. Enterprise projects can identify targets, forms, courses and frequency of training in delivery programmes. |
| ** How does Kuailu AI CRM support sales teams and clients? ** | Kuailu AI CRM supports information management, such as trails, clients, contacts, business opportunities, directors, collaborators and follow-up missions, and facilitates client flow through privileges and rules; specific AI capabilities and automation ranges are based on current versions and configurations. |
| ** Can regular staff complete the forms without login? ** | Some forms can be submitted on an external link to the product version and security configuration; anonymous scope, field privileges, identification and data processing rules need to be configured by administrators. |
